title: capability card — one onboarded environment (spec) as the builder can use it

role.description: what software it stands in for, e.g. 'helpdesk (Zendesk-like)'

kinds.description: {kind: [write tool names that realize it]}; every kind must be in vocab.kind_tools or be proposed with 'other:' prefix

check_kinds.description: which vocab.check_kinds a contract can evaluate on this app's entities (row/record/mail/post…)

carriers.description: {carrier: {entity, field}} — where a literal policy text can be seeded

arguments.description: Optional exact native login parameters. $password and $persona refer to the generated world credentials; literal selectors and numeric ids keep their source types.

login.description: Explicit null means there is no login interface; use the app directly. Missing declarations are not inferred.

content_entities.description: entities whose rows are task content (seeded per pack; listed in packlib CONTENT)

seed_helpers.description: helper function names the register file exposes for seeding (e.g. tracker_project)

tool_families_to_keep.description: tool-name prefixes a pack should keep when pruning the tool panel (<=350 tools per world)

obs_reads.description: the whole-list reads an agent makes (must stay under 12k chars) — the register's obs hook covers them
